stories.headline: GSTN issues advisories on registration amendment and e-invoice downtime
points: Per a 1 Nov 2026 advisory, only Principal Place of Business amendments still need the Proper Officer's approval.
Other registration changes are auto-amended after online validation, with OTP verification needed within 3 days or no ARN.
A scheduled upgrade pauses e-Invoice retrieval, GSTR-1 auto-population and e-Invoice JSON downloads on the portal.
stories.why_it_matters: Registration changes, portal timelines and GSTR-1 data flows are routine compliance work for CA and CMA professionals handling GST.
stories.source_title: Goods and Services Tax | GSTN Advisories on Registration, Cancellation and Composition Compliance Procedures

stories.headline: SEBI updates Master Circular for Alternative Investment Funds
points: SEBI revised its AIF Master Circular on Nov 5, 2026; the original version was dated June 3, 2026.
It adds recent circulars on AIF winding up, Inoperative Fund status, GARUDA and the Accredited Investor framework.
Trustee, sponsor or manager must ensure the Compliance Test Report covers all chapters of the Master Circular.
stories.why_it_matters: AIF compliance reports and regulatory reporting are areas where CAs and CMAs handle audit, certification and compliance work.
stories.source_title: SEBI | SEBI AIF Master Circular Updated November 5, 2026: New Accredited Investor Framework and Compliance Rules

stories.headline: Tribunal backs ₹54 lakh property attachment in Chhattisgarh liquor case
points: The SAFEMA Appellate Tribunal upheld attachment of a ₹54 lakh property interest of an excise officer under PMLA.
The property was bought in 2015, but the ED alleges the crime period was 2019 to 2022; the officer argued this protected it.
Tribunal held other property can be attached for equivalent value when the actual proceeds are not available.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how 'proceeds of crime' under PMLA includes value, a point relevant to law, compliance and forensic audit studies.
stories.source_title: Fema / RBI | PMLA: Tribunal Upholds ₹54 Lakh Attachment of Property Bought Before Alleged Liquor Scam
